newsitem.title: JAPAN: Markets decide forex impact of Japan surplus--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Markets decide forex impact of Japan surplus--MOF.

text.p: It is up to the markets to decide the effect of Japan's trade surplus on foreign exchange rates, Japanese Vice Finance Minister Takeshi Komura told a news conference on Monday.
Asked how the ministry viewed Japan's rising trade surplus and the impact on foreign exchange rates, Komura said: "Evaluation of the surplus differs from person to person."
Komura added: "The level of foreign exchange rates following the release of Japan's July trade surplus data earlier today was a reflection of the market's assessment."
He said the exchange rate level will settle down at a point decided by the market.
Japan's overall trade surplus rose 69.7 percent in July to 849.1 billion yen, the Finance Ministry said on Monday morning.
Komura reiterated the ministry's view that the data was affected by the rise in Japan's sales tax in April.
